Wearing the colors

At 15, Ahmed already carries eight KingDom titles and a place on Jordan's national team — earned across six seasons, two of them with double championship runs.

From a first title in 2021 to the title he now defends in 2026, the record reads as a straight line up: every season, a new belt.
